description: This file defines the 'CronJobsStore' class, a singleton observable object responsible for managing and orchestrating cron job operations in a macOS application. It includes methods for starting/stopping polling, refreshing job and run data, handling gateway push events, and updating job statuses. The class interacts with external connection and gateway services and maintains internal state such as scheduled tasks, job lists, and error messages.

classes.name: CronJobsStore
classes.description: A singleton class that manages cron job data, scheduling, and event handling in a Swift macOS application, providing an interface for job operations and reacting to gateway push events.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts polling and event listening for cron jobs unless in preview mode.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Cancels ongoing background tasks related to polling and event listening.

methods.name: refreshJobs
methods.description: Fetches the list of cron jobs and updates internal state accordingly.

methods.name: refreshRuns
methods.description: Retrieves recent runs for a specific job ID.

methods.name: runJob
methods.description: Triggers execution of a specified cron job, optionally forcing it.

methods.name: removeJob
methods.description: Removes a specified cron job and refreshes the job list.

methods.name: setJobEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a specified cron job.

methods.name: upsertJob
methods.description: Adds or updates a cron job with provided payload.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes incoming gateway push events and reacts accordingly.

methods.name: scheduleRefresh
methods.description: Schedules a delayed refresh of job list.

methods.name: scheduleRunsRefresh
methods.description: Schedules a delayed refresh of job runs for a specific job.
